compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Israel completes the tabernacle work according to command, brings it to Moses, and receives his blessing after inspection.
observations.label: The dwelling work is inspected and blessed

observations.body: The dwelling work is inspected and blessed belongs to tablets and dwelling in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 39:32–43 supplies consequence evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: What follows from Sinai

observations.body: The tablets and dwelling instructions develop the consequences of Sinai presence; they are not additional lines inside the Ten Words.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 39:32–43 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The dwelling work is inspected and blessed follows from Sinai while remaining distinct from the words and actions at the mountain itself.
payload.title: The dwelling work is inspected and blessed
